prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 组件版本兼容矩阵 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "组件" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 112px
  col 2: header "v1.x" · longest unbreakable word 29px · one-line width 62px
  col 3: header "v2.x" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 62px
  col 4: header "v3.x" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 62px
  col 5: header "说明" · longest unbreakable word 171px · one-line width 494px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
This table cannot fit without splitting words at 360px. You MAY choose a total wider than 359px (the reader then scrolls horizontally), or squeeze and accept splits — a design decision.
Rendering convention: the screenshot always shows the WHOLE table. Anything beyond the dashed box is not clipped; it is the part a reader reaches by scrolling sideways, so judge both what fits in the box at first sight and the cost of scrolling to the rest.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示各组件在 v1.x、v2.x 和 v3.x 中的支持情况及相关限制，帮助读者判断版本兼容性。","reading":"读者先按组件定位行，再横向比较三个版本的状态，最后查看说明中的条件或例外。","groups":["v1.x、v2.x、v3.x 是并列的状态列，应保持一致的宽度，便于逐列比较。","组件与三个版本状态共同构成主要矩阵；说明列补充每行的兼容条件。"],"keep_intact":["版本标识 v1.x、v2.x、v3.x","支持状态，如“✓ 支持”“× 不支持”“部分支持”","组件名称中的 SDK 等标识，以及说明中的版本号和长标识"],"may_wrap":["组件名称可在自然的词语边界换行。","说明文字可按中文语意换行，并可利用状态较长的行产生的高度。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [83, 83, 83, 83, 192] · table 525×640px · row heights [36, 83, 83, 83, 106, 83, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 165px
Design r2B: widths [78, 83, 83, 83, 192] · table 520×640px · row heights [36, 83, 83, 83, 106, 83, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 160px
Design r2C: widths [83, 80, 80, 80, 192] · table 516×640px · row heights [36, 83, 83, 83, 106, 83, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 156px

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"三个版本列等宽，支持状态保持在一行，便于横向比较；组件名称多数分成两行，说明中的长标识也保持完整。","problems":"说明列的大部分位于首屏之外，读者需要横向滚动才能查看条件；组件名称仍有不够自然的断行。","cause":"组件列为83px，可用文字宽度62px；说明列为192px，但它从第332px处才开始。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"版本列和说明列的宽度与r2A相同，状态保持完整，表格也稍窄。","problems":"多个组件名称被挤成三行，词语被拆开，行内阅读节奏变差；缩窄5px对说明列的首屏可见范围帮助很小。","cause":"组件列从83px缩到78px后，可用文字宽度仅57px，不足以容纳原本同一行的部分文字。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"三个版本列仍然等宽，组件列保留了r2A的宽度，整体横向溢出略少。","problems":"“部分支持”和“不支持”等状态在多处断成两行，破坏版本间快速比较；节省的宽度也不足以让说明列在首屏有实质性的可读空间。","cause":"每个版本列缩至80px，可用文字宽度59px，小于状态的一行宽度62px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"组件优先","widths":[103,83,83,83,192],"change":"将组件列加宽至103px，给组件名称更自然的换行空间；三个版本列保持完整状态，说明列保持长标识完整。代价是说明列需要更多横向滚动。"},{"name":"说明舒展","widths":[83,83,83,83,220],"change":"以r2A为基础加宽说明列，让条件文字有更从容的换行空间，同时保留完整状态和较紧凑的主矩阵；用于检验更宽的说明能否改善行高与阅读节奏。"},{"name":"首屏矩阵","widths":[100,69,69,69,192],"change":"尝试让组件列和三个等宽版本列合计307px，使首屏能看到说明列的开头；接受较长状态换行，以检验减少横向滚动是否值得牺牲状态列的紧凑性。"}]}
